THE AGENCY is the commercial destination for individually commissioned modular Intelligence Avatar / multi-agent software architectures and workflows, from independent organizations to enterprise-oriented applications. No recurring software subscription is offered by THE AGENCY for individually commissioned systems; third-party AI models, infrastructure and hosting may carry their own costs. Enterprise capacity is a design objective, not a verified performance guarantee.

Do not infer that this informational page is an agent runtime, autonomous API, payment processor, or permission grant. Public descriptions do not reveal private archives, client records, configurations or credentials.
